title: urlSync bug with base attribute
body:
Hello,

There is a bug happening when `urlSync: true` and the html page has a `base` attribute which is different from the current URL. It will instantly replace the URL with the `base` url, to which is appended the instantsearch.js state as a query string

Demo: http://url-syncbug.surge.sh/test

The base attribute is: 

``` html
<base href="http://url-syncbug.surge.sh">
```

The page URL is instantly changed to http://url-syncbug.surge.sh/?q=rake&hPP=6&idx=Version_development&p=0&is_v=1

One solution could be to replace the entire URI path instead of just the query params part

comments.body:
Working on this, got a fix (use the full url). The underlying issue is that as soon as you use a base href,  when you push relative things inside pushState or location.href then they are resolved to the base href tag.

Which can either:
- result in a full page load (when using #)
- result in a security issue (when using pushState)
@GabrielDelepine this should already be fixed in latest version, wonder why did you had to fix it? Are you on latest version?

Hi @vvo 

The fix is in the master branch. I am waiting for the release `1.4.3`.
@GabrielDelepine The fix was done and is available in 1.4.2, that's why I am wondering. See https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/e58aadcd9aae77165b802b46a7d3de5864569e1e
Please open a new issue if you still have problems with urlSync and base tag
